::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 8th 1860  
**From:** Otterbourne,Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS New York Public Library, De Coursey Fales Collection/2
:::

My dear [Sir](people/person_1143.qmd),

Many thanks for the three critiques on [Mlle Mori](other_books/otherbook_270.qmd)which I hope to shew [Miss Roberts](people/person_1244.qmd).

I think there is a good deal of one sidedness in the [Literary Gazette](organizations/other_143.qmd)- as though written by a person who saw from only one point of view.

I cannot judge whether the characters are too English but I fully believe Miss Roberts had authority for some of the things here represented as impossible and I wonder whether the writer has any grounds for the ‘simply not true’, that the hero and heroine were unlikely to receive alms because not Roman Catholics.

yours with thanks

CMYonge
